description:
Do you know how to file a third party car insurance claim in India?
Many car owners think they’re covered, but when an accident happens, they don’t know the third party car insurance claim process — and most claims fail because of small mistakes.

📑25 Lessons I wish I Knew (e-book) - https://bit.ly/41MEODP
     Read On KIndle- https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0F295T5VG
📲 Ask your query - https://bit.ly/3FJium2
🔔 Join the Impact Buddy family - https://bit.ly/4l7cvra      
Join 🟢💬 WhatsApp & Stay ahead ! 📢✨ https://bit.ly/4hrGGGL

In this video, I explain the complete step-by-step process of third party car insurance claims, including how to file an FIR, deal with the other party, submit claim forms, and handle the surveyor’s inspection. I also share common reasons why third party insurance claims get rejected — so you can avoid these costly errors.

👉 Whether you’re a car owner, bike owner, or anyone who drives on Indian roads, understanding how to claim third party car insurance is a must. Many people confuse comprehensive insurance and third party insurance, but the claim process is very different.

📌 What you’ll learn in this video:

What is third party car insurance?

How third party insurance claim settlement works in India

Documents required for third party insurance claim

Time limit for filing a third party claim

Third party motor insurance claim process for accidental damage

Common mistakes in third party insurance claims

How to increase chances of successful claim settlement

If you have a third party motor insurance policy, this guide will help you protect your rights and get your claim approved without stress. This information is useful for four wheeler insurance, car insurance, bike insurance, and even commercial vehicle third party claims.

🚗💡 Relevant keywords covered:
#thirdpartyinsurance #carinsuranceclaim #thirdpartyclaim #motorinsurance #accidentclaim #insuranceclaimprocess #vehicleinsurance #insuranceinhindi #insuranceclaimsettlement #thirdpartycarinsuranceindia

✅ If you found this video helpful, please LIKE, SHARE, and COMMENT your questions below.
🔔 Don’t forget to SUBSCRIBE to my channel for more real, practical insurance advice and tips to protect your hard-earned money.

Stay informed. Stay protected.
Thanks for watching!

It's a routine thing on Indian roads. Can tell them to file a case or convince them to get the vehicle repaired at the workshop of our choice.
Or you can ask them to claim it in their insurance policy, you can pay for the processing fee, and NCB loss.
It's a very situational thing to decide what works and what doesn't. 
As everything depends on who we are dealing with.
